production.note: US model years. First model year 2008: BMW NA's technical data sheet is titled '2008 BMW M3 Coupe' (bmw-us-2008-m3-coupe-techdata). Last model year 2013: BMW NA's 2014 Model Year Changes says "There won't be a 2014 M3 Coupe and Convertible in the US market, production of the M3 Coupe ended in June 2013 while the M3 Convertible will be produced until October 2013." The sedan ended earlier; its last US model year was not confirmed from an opened page.

body.note: Sedan (E90) per bmw-us-2007-m3-sedan-release; coupe (E92) per bmw-us-2008-m3-coupe-techdata; convertible (E93) per bmw-us-2009-m3-convertible-techdata.

configuration.note: 'Engine Type / Cylinder / Valves per Cylinder - 90° V / 8 / 4'

aspiration.note: Inferred from BMW NA's description of the 'high-revving 414-horsepower V8'; the spec sheet lists no forced induction.

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive with Variable M Differential Lock.

transmission.note: The 2009 sheet lists 'Manual 6 Speed' and 'M3 (DCT) ... Auto 7 Speed'. DCT is BMW's M Double Clutch Transmission (M DCT), which followed the manual; the coupe was launched with the manual only (bmw-us-2007-m3-coupe-release: 'close-ratio six-speed manual gearbox').

powerHp.note: Quote: "Power SAE hp / rpm 414 / 8300". The same rating is given for the convertible and in bmw-us-2007-m3-coupe-release: "produces 414 hp at 8,300 rpm".

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Curb Weight kg / lbs 1680 / 3704". The convertible is 4,145 lb (bmw-us-2009-m3-convertible-techdata).
